expectedIssues: An icon is missing from the top right corner, only a red dot is visible
reportedIssues: The circular button at the top right is an empty grey circle with only a small red dot. It has no icon, avatar or initials, so its purpose is unclear. It looks like an icon or image that failed to load, and the red dot has no clear meaning (notification badge?).

The delivery-time pills (e.g. '15–25 min') overlap the bottom-left of the images. The white pill on the light Green Bowl Poké image has weak separation from the background, and the pill sits over the plate edge.
The secondary grey text (delivery fees, the search placeholder, the '(500+)' rating count, inactive nav labels) is light grey on white/light grey and has low contrast.

The heart/favorite button is styled inconsistently across cards: on the ramen card it is a dark translucent circle that barely shows against the dark image, while the pizza card has a visibly different circle.
